Otherwise the remaining gap per D is reported.

expected_minutes.basis: prebuild + requalification + race about 20 min; selection about 30 min; 40 comparisons x 5 starts about 60 min on four lanes

plan.node_reason: One H100 node (4 H100): independent single-GPU lanes
